answer: Each agent must stake a unique jade token bound to a hardware-rooted ivory key, and every epoch it solves a fresh cipher challenge whose solution feeds a verifiable delay function; forging identities means acquiring new hardware keys and paying the escalating stake plus compute cost, so the marginal cost per sybil rises faster than any reward, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
